answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use staked vouching: each new agent must be vouched by established peers who post bonds that burn if the entrant cheats, so fake identities become a costly liability instead of a cheap zephyr of accounts. Reputation accrues only through verifiable work histories and, like a sonnet, its value lies in strict form, so a fresh identity cannot fake seniority overnight. Fees stay crystal clear: every attestation is paid, making mass registration uneconomical.
